title: Competition and Agency Problems Within Banks: Evidence from Insider Lending
eligible_reason: Staggered state-level interstate branching deregulation (13 distinct deregulation quarters between 1995Q1 and 2000Q3 across 42 states; 8 never-deregulating states) estimated with bank and quarter fixed effects. The paper's headline regressor is a continuous 0-4 competition index (ineligible), but two reported specifications use binary relative-time indicators without controls: the Figure 1 quarterly event study and the Table III binned event-study column.
design_notes: From Comp_InsLending_Code.do (analysis section lines 198-676) and Comp_InsLending_Data.dta. Unit: bank (cert, FDIC certificate); time: quarter (Time_Quarter, 1994Q1-2005Q2; 1994Q1 has missing Comp_Index). Treatment: state deregulation. Comp_Index is the authors' competition index (values 0-4; 0 = not yet deregulated); Dereg = (Comp_Index != 0). time_0 = last quarter with Comp_Index==0 in the bank's state; norm_time = Time_Quarter - time_0, so norm_time==0 is the last pre-deregulation quarter (omitted period). States with Comp_Index==0 through 2005Q2 (AR, CO, IA, KS, MO, MS, MT, NE) have norm_time missing and all relative-time indicators zero (never treated). AK has Comp_Index>0 throughout (always treated); its indicators are also all zero. No state switches back to 0. Cohort distribution (time_0): 1994Q4:1, 1995Q1:3, 1995Q2:8, 1995Q3:1, 1995Q4:1, 1996Q1:6, 1996Q2:3, 1996Q4:1, 1997Q1:14, 1999Q2:1, 1999Q4:1, 2000Q1:1, 2000Q2:1. Sample: int_sample = nonmissing insider-loan ratios & stock institutions; comm = commercial banks (bkclass not SA/SB); approx. 384,240 bank-quarters, 12,348 banks, 51 states. Outcome InsLoans_UnimpairedCap = insider loans / (Tier1 + Tier2 capital), trimmed to [0,1]. Figure 1: reghdfe InsLoans_UnimpairedCap treat__1-treat_42 (varlist range covering leads -24..-1 and lags +1..+42), a(cert Time_Quarter) cl(cert). Table III: col 1 Comp_Index with cert+quarter FE (defines e_sample_did); cols 2-6 add state FE variants and controls (log_PersInc, D_log_PersInc, HHI, market share, bank controls); col with Dereg + controls; final col Dereg__2 Dereg__1 Dereg_1 Dereg_2 (bins <-8, -8..-1, 1..8, >8) without controls. Table IV / Figure 2: triple difference with commercial-bank interaction and state x quarter FE. Table V: subsamples with continuous index. Table VII: IV. Table VIII (Comp_OpCosts_Inter_Code.do): Dereg with controls.

specs.treatment_var: treat__q = (norm_time==-q) for q=1..24 and treat_q = (norm_time==q) for q=1..42, where norm_time = Time_Quarter - time_0 and time_0 = last quarter with Comp_Index==0 in the bank's state (binary deregulation Dereg = Comp_Index!=0)
specs.sample_condition: int_sample==1 & Comp_Index!=. & comm==1 (stock commercial banks with nonmissing insider-loan ratios)
specs.event_bins: single quarters -24..-1 and +1..+42; omitted: norm_time==0 (last untreated quarter) plus never-/always-treated and norm_time<-24
specs.notes: Variables built at lines 205-225 (stalp_g, comm, int_sample, time_0, norm_time, treat dummies). Static TWFE counterpart with Dereg and no controls is not reported (Dereg static column includes controls).

specs.treatment_var: Dereg__2 = norm_time<-8; Dereg__1 = -8<=norm_time<=-1; Dereg_1 = 1<=norm_time<=8; Dereg_2 = norm_time>8 (binary deregulation Dereg = Comp_Index!=0)
specs.sample_condition: e_sample_did==1 (estimation sample of Table III col 1: comm==1 & int_sample==1 & Comp_Index!=. & outcome nonmissing)
specs.reported_location: Table III, last column (binned dynamic effects)
specs.notes: Variables built at lines 372-401 (time_0, norm_time, Dereg, Dereg bins).

screener_notes: Eligible on the binary event-study specifications only; the paper's preferred estimates use the continuous competition index. AK is always treated and enters the reference group together with never-treated states; the CSA/BJS re-estimation should drop AK or treat it as always-treated per protocol. Year in frame is 2021; the article appeared in MS 68(5) 2022 (verify). Need the article to map S2 to its Table III column number and to record coefficients.
